description: Overview of UDP and TCP traffic plus exporter health. The dashboard is split into collapsible sections so summary and detailed traffic panels can be hidden independently.

panels.description: Number of active UDP operator sessions for the selected filters when session labels are present; falls back to raw stream count outside operator-managed environments.

targets.expr: ((count(count by (session_id) (iperf_exporter_udp_bandwidth{measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", network_mode=~"$network_mode", connection_pair=~"$connection_pair", session_id!=""})) ) or vector(0)) + (((count(count by (connection_pair, peer_port, peer_id) (iperf_exporter_udp_bandwidth{measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", measurement_id=~"$measurement_id", profile_ref=~"$profile_ref", execution_mode=~"$execution_mode", direction=~"$direction", src_cluster=~"$src_cluster", src_node=~"$src_node", dst_cluster=~"$dst_cluster", dst_node=~"$dst_node", network_mode=~"$network_mode", connection_pair=~"$connection_pair", session_id=""})) )) or vector(0))
